source.title: Ulster Herald, 10 June 1967, p. 12 ("Tyrone County Council: notice of result of election 1967"); Strabane Chronicle, 27 May 1967, p. 1 ("Strabane county council contest: polling next Thursday")
source.publisher: Ulster Herald (via the Irish Newspaper Archives)
source.check: returned unopposed: the Returning Officer's notice declares the persons named duly elected for each county electoral division (Ulster Herald, 10 June 1967); the only poll was at Strabane

note: Election of the Tyrone County Council, polled 1 June 1967. Twenty-six divisions were returned unopposed; Strabane was the only contest (Belfast Telegraph, 2 June 1967, p. 8). The official notice prints the surname only in the candidate column; the given-name column is not recoverable from the OCR of the page. Returned unopposed.
